    "function scpr_activate_bcsets_remote.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTIVATION_TYPE) TYPE  I DEFAULT 1",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFCDEST) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSTEM) TYPE  SYSYSID DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(MANDANT) TYPE  MANDT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASK_NUMBER_SYST) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASK_NUMBER_CUST) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(SIMULATION_ON) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(REMOTE_TYPE) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLETE_ONLY) TYPE  I DEFAULT 1",
    "*\"     VALUE(WRITE_STATUS) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTLINKS) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_STANDARD) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TRANSPORT_OFF) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(SAFETY) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(SYSEDIT_OFF) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(CALL_FROM) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASKNAME) TYPE  SCPRTASK DEFAULT 'ACTIV'",
    "*\"     VALUE(BATCH_MODE) TYPE  SCPRBATCH DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(BATCH_IMMEDIATELY) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(BATCH_DATE) TYPE  BTCSDATE DEFAULT '00000000'",
    "*\"     VALUE(BATCH_TIME) TYPE  BTCSTIME DEFAULT '000000'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VARIABLES_OFF) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(AFTER_IMP) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'Y'",
    "*\"     VALUE(LANGU_ONLY) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT 'N'",
    "*\"     VALUE(CATEGORY) TYPE  SCPR_CTGRY DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(PROTO_HANDLE) TYPE  SCPR_HANDL",
    "*\"     VALUE(RC_ACTIV) TYPE  SCPRACST",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASK_SYST_EXP) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASK_CUST_EXP) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(AFT_IMP_DATA) TYPE  SCPRAFTIMPTAB",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      BCSET_IDS STRUCTURE  SCPR_PARNT",
    "*\"      VARIABLES STRUCTURE  SCPRVARI OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(VARIABLES_NEW) TYPE  SCPRVART OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      NO_BCSET",
    "*\"      WRONG_PARAMETERS",
    "*\"      NO_RFC_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      RFC_FAILURE",
    "*\"      INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "*\"      BATCHJOB_ERROR",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "* fields",
    "  data control_system      like sy-sysid.",
    "  data control_user        like sy-uname.",
    "  data cus_transp_on       type c.",
    "  data display_mode        type c.",
    "  data exception           type c.",
    "  data fcode(4)            type c.",
    "  data msg_text(80)        type c.",
    "  data msgvar1             type symsgv.",
    "  data rc_temp             like sy-subrc.",
    "  data sys_transp_on       type c.",
    "  data upgrade_mode        type c.",
    "  data variable            type scprvari.",
    "  data variable_new        type scprvarl.",
    "  data with_message        type c.",
    "",
    "* structures",
    "  data actopts      type scpractopt.",
    "  data bcset_parent type scpr_parnt.",
    "  data error_temp   type scp1_general_error.",
    "  data objvalue     type scpr_objval.",
    "  data para         type rsparams.",
    "",
    "* tables",
    "  data bcsets_temp   type SCPR_BCSETS.",
    "  data bcsets_temp2  type scpr_plist.",
    "  data errors        type SCP1_GENERAL_ERRORS.",
    "  data languages     type SCPR_LANGUAGES.",
    "  data objvalues     type SCPR_OBJVALS.",
    "  data paras         type SCP1_RSPARAMS_TAB.",
    "  data recattr       like standard table of scprreca.",
    "  data values        like standard table of scprvals.",
    "  data valuesl       like standard table of scprvall.",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* check import parameters",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* check remote_type",
    "  if not remote_type is initial",
    "                     and remote_type <> remote_type_synchron",
    "                     and remote_type <> remote_type_asynchron",
    "                     and remote_type <> remote_type_asynchron_wait",
    "                     and remote_type <> remote_type_transactional.",
    "    msgvar1 = remote_type.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'REMOTE_TYPE'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check rfcdest: initial = local activation",
    "* check combination of rfcdest and remote_type -> allowed combinations:",
    "*    rfcdest   | remote_type | result",
    "* -------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*    initial   |  Space or S | activation in local system and client",
    "*  destination |      S      | synchronous RFC activation",
    "*  destination |     A,W     | asynchronous RFC activations",
    "*  destination |      T      | transactional RFC (not yet supported)",
    "  if rfcdest is initial.",
    "  else.",
    "    if remote_type <> remote_type_synchron and",
    "       remote_type <> remote_type_asynchron and",
    "       remote_type <> remote_type_asynchron_wait and",
    "       remote_type <> remote_type_transactional.",
    "      message e273 raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check variables",
    "  if not variables is initial and not variables_new is initial.",
    "    message e273 raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check bcsets",
    "  describe table bcset_ids.",
    "  if sy-tfill = 0.",
    "    message e223 raising NO_BCSET.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check mandant and system",
    "  if not write_status is initial and",
    "     ( mandant is initial or system is initial ).",
    "    message e273 raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check batch_mode",
    "* planing a batch mode activation is only possible for local client",
    "* (rfcdest = ' ')",
    "  if ( batch_mode <> answer_no and batch_mode <> answer_yes ) or",
    "   ( batch_mode = answer_yes and rfcdest <> ' ' ).",
    "    if batch_mode is initial.",
    "      msgvar1 = 'Initialwert'(001).",
    "    else.",
    "      msgvar1 = batch_mode.",
    "    endif.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'BATCH_MODE'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check batch_immediately",
    "  if ( batch_immediately <> answer_no",
    "                              and batch_immediately <> answer_yes )",
    "    or ( batch_immediately = answer_yes and batch_mode = answer_no ).",
    "    if batch_mode is initial.",
    "      msgvar1 = 'Initialwert'(001).",
    "    else.",
    "      msgvar1 = batch_mode.",
    "    endif.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'BATCH_IMMEDIATELY'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check batch_date",
    "  if not batch_date is initial and batch_mode <> answer_yes.",
    "    msgvar1 = batch_mode.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'BATCH_DATE'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check batch_time",
    "  if not batch_time is initial and batch_mode <> answer_yes.",
    "    msgvar1 = batch_mode.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'BATCH_TIME'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check after_imp",
    "  if after_imp <> answer_no and after_imp <> answer_yes.",
    "    if after_imp is initial.",
    "      msgvar1 = 'Initialwert'(001).",
    "    else.",
    "      msgvar1 = after_imp.",
    "    endif.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'AFTER_IMP'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check langu_only",
    "  if langu_only <> answer_no and langu_only <> answer_yes.",
    "    if langu_only is initial.",
    "      msgvar1 = 'Initialwert'(001).",
    "    else.",
    "      msgvar1 = langu_only.",
    "    endif.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'LANGU_ONLY'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check category",
    "  if category <> pcat_classic.",
    "    msgvar1 = category.",
    "    message e551 with msgvar1 'CATEGORY'",
    "              'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE' raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* initialize",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* if necessary, the variables structure is changed",
    "  if variables is requested and not variables is initial.",
    "    refresh: variables_new.",
    "    loop at variables into variable.",
    "      move-corresponding variable to variable_new.",
    "      append variable_new to variables_new.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* get activation-id (Guid)",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_UUID_CREATE'",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      PROTO_HANDLE = proto_handle.",
    "",
    "* get control_system",
    "  control_system = sy-sysid.",
    "",
    "* get control_user",
    "  control_user = sy-uname.",
    "",
    "",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* check authorities",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* check bcset-authority",
    "  if not rfcdest is initial and call_from <> cf_distribution.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        TASK             = 'ACTIVATE'",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1",
    "        NO_AUTHORITY     = 2",
    "        OTHERS           = 3.",
    "    case sy-subrc.",
    "      when 0.",
    "      when 1.",
    "        message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "      when 2.",
    "        message e247 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                       raising NO_AUTHORITY.",
    "      when others.",
    "        message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "    endcase.",
    "    if complete_only = 2.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          TASK             = 'ACTUNCHKT'",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1",
    "          NO_AUTHORITY     = 2",
    "          OTHERS           = 3.",
    "      case sy-subrc.",
    "        when 0.",
    "        when 1.",
    "          message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                  with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "        when 2.",
    "          message e379 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                      raising NO_AUTHORITY.",
    "        when others.",
    "          message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                  with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "      endcase.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "* check authority for rfc-call",
    "  if not rfcdest is initial.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK_RFC'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        USERID           = SY-UNAME",
    "        FUNCTIONGROUP    = 'SCPRAC'",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        USER_DONT_EXIST  = 1",
    "        RFC_NO_AUTHORITY = 2",
    "        OTHERS           = 3.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "      message e245 raising NO_RFC_Authority.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "  if batch_mode = answer_no.",
    "    case remote_type.",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* synchronous remote-activation",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "      when remote_type_synchron or ' '.",
    "        call function 'SCPR_ACTIV_MN_REMOTE_SUB'",
    "          destination rfcdest",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            activation_type       = activation_type",
    "            proto_handle          = proto_handle",
    "            control_system        = control_system",
    "            control_user          = control_user",
    "            task_number_syst      = task_number_syst",
    "            task_number_cust      = task_number_cust",
    "            simulation_on         = simulation_on",
    "            complete_only         = complete_only",
    "            var_with_language     = 'X'",
    "            ACTLINKS              = actlinks",
    "            NO_STANDARD           = no_standard",
    "            TRANSPORT_OFF         = transport_off",
    "            SYSEDIT_OFF           = sysedit_off",
    "            SAFETY                = safety",
    "            variables_new         = variables_new",
    "            CALL_FROM             = call_from",
    "            VARIABLES_OFF         = variables_off",
    "            AFTER_IMP             = after_imp",
    "            LANGU_ONLY            = langu_only",
    "            CATEGORY              = category",
    "          IMPORTING",
    "            rc_activ              = rc_activ",
    "            variables_out         = variables_new",
    "            task_syst_exp         = task_syst_exp",
    "            task_cust_exp         = task_cust_exp",
    "            aft_imp_data          = aft_imp_data",
    "          TABLES",
    "            bcset_ids             = bcset_ids",
    "            recattr               = recattr",
    "            values                = values",
    "            valuesl               = valuesl",
    "          EXCEPTIONS",
    "            COMMUNICATION_FAILURE = 1  message msg_text",
    "            SYSTEM_FAILURE        = 2  message msg_text",
    "            NO_BCSET              = 3",
    "            WRONG_PARAMETERS      = 4",
    "            NO_AUTHORITY          = 5",
    "            INTERNAL_ERROR        = 6.",
    "        case sy-subrc.",
    "          when 0.",
    "          when 1 or 2.",
    "            msgvar1 = msg_text.",
    "            export msgvar1 to memory id 'rfc-errormessage'.",
    "            message e276 with msgvar1 raising RFC_FAILURE.",
    "          when 3.",
    "            message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                    with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                    raising NO_BCSET.",
    "          when 4.",
    "            message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                    with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                    raising WRONG_PARAMETERS.",
    "          when 5.",
    "            MESSAGE ID 'SCPR' TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                     WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                     raising NO_AUTHORITY.",
    "          when others.",
    "            if sy-msgno is initial.",
    "              message e320 raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "            else.",
    "              message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                      with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                      raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "            endif.",
    "        endcase.",
    "* falls die Statusprotokollierung nicht ausgeschaltet ist, wird noch",
    "* pro BC-Set der Aktivierungsstatus weggeschrieben",
    "        if not write_status is initial.",
    "          loop at bcset_ids into bcset_parent.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_DB_ACTSTATUS_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                SYSTEM_ID      = system",
    "                MANDANT        = mandant",
    "                BCSET          = bcset_parent-bcset_id",
    "                CATEGORY       = category",
    "                ACT_STATUS     = bcset_parent-act_status",
    "                ACT_NR         = proto_handle",
    "                ACT_USER       = control_user",
    "                ACT_DATE       = bcset_parent-act_date",
    "                ACT_TIME       = bcset_parent-act_time",
    "              EXCEPTIONS",
    "                KEY_INCOMPLETE = 1",
    "                OTHERS         = 2.",
    "            case sy-subrc.",
    "              when 0.",
    "              when 1.",
    "                message e295 raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "              when others.",
    "                if sy-msgno is initial.",
    "                  message e320 raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "                else.",
    "                  message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                          with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                          raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "                endif.",
    "            endcase.",
    "          endloop.",
    "        endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "      when remote_type_asynchron_wait.",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* asynchronous remote-activation with waiting of answer",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "* asynchronous RFC including waiting for answer",
    "        clear: async_flag.",

    "*********************************************************************",

    "*********************************************************************",
    "* check if actual client is productive:",
    "* in dialog: stop activation with info (without protocol)",
    "* non-dialog: stop activation with protocol",
    "  clear: systype, systemedit, system_client_edit, sys_cliinddep_edit,",
    "         rc_temp.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_SYS_PARAMS'",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      SYSTEMEDIT         = systemedit",
    "      SYSTEM_CLIENT_EDIT = system_client_edit",
    "      SYS_CLIINDDEP_EDIT = sys_cliinddep_edit",
    "      SYSTEM_CLIENT_ROLE = systype",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      NO_SYSTEMNAME      = 1",
    "      NO_SYSTEMTYPE      = 2",
    "      OTHERS             = 3.",
    "  rc_temp = sy-subrc.",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "       and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-sysedt_off <> answer_yes.",
    "    IF rc_temp <> 0 or systype is initial or ( systype = 'P' and allow_productive_adjustment is initial ).",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "        IF systype = 'P'.",
    "          MESSAGE i230.",
    "          \" Give appropriate msg if Client Role is not maintained",
    "        ELSEIF systype IS INITIAL.",
    "          MESSAGE i123(tb).",
    "          \" Borrowing msg from ALO!",
    "          \" SRE 06.05.2008",
    "        else.",
    "          message i353.",
    "        endif.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW = err_end",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD = rc_activ.",
    "      else.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW = err_stop",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD = rc_activ.",
    "        clear msgnum.",
    "        IF systype = 'P'.",
    "          IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e230. ENDIF.",
    "          msgnum = '230'.",
    "          \" Log appropriate msg if Client Role is not maintained",
    "        ELSEIF systype IS INITIAL.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id = actopts-act_id",
    "              msgid  = 'TB'",
    "              msgty  = err_stop",
    "              msgno  = '123'.",
    "          \" Borrowing msg from ALO package STAB!",
    "          \" add Processing cancelled in log",
    "          msgnum = '018'.",
    "          \" SRE 06.05.2008",
    "        else.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e353. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '353'.",
    "        endif.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID = actopts-act_id",
    "            MSGID  = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY  = err_stop",
    "            MSGNO  = msgnum.",

    "*********************************************************************",
    "*                        expand bcsets",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* Kopieren der Übergabeliste von BC-Set Namen (bcset_ids) in die",
    "* Aktivierungsliste (bcsets_attrs). in bcsets_attrs steht pro",
    "* übergebenem bc-set eine zeile mit dem namen. in bcset_ids werden",
    "* zunächst alle status auf 'B' gesetzt. diese werden am ende der",
    "* aktivierung mit den tatsächlichen stati aktualisiert.",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    refresh: bcsets_attrs.",
    "    loop at bcset_ids into bcset_parent.",
    "      move bcset_parent-bcset_id to attr_temp-id.",
    "      append attr_temp to bcsets_attrs.",
    "      bcset_parent-act_status = 'B'.",
    "      modify bcset_ids from bcset_parent transporting act_status.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    sort bcsets_attrs.",
    "    delete adjacent duplicates from bcsets_attrs comparing id.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* get bcset properties:",
    "* bcset_attrs: filled with bcset attributes (if bcset is not found, the",
    "* attributes remain empty)",
    "* bcsets_parents: filled with all simple, generated and not found bcsets",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    clear: attr_temp.",
    "    refresh: bcsets_parents.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp.",
    "      clear: bcset_parent.",
    "      data: l_reftype type scprattr-reftype,",
    "            l_refname type scprattr-refname.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_DB_ATTR_GET_DETAIL'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          PROFID             = attr_temp-id",
    "          CATEGORY           = actopts-category",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          PROFTYPE           = attr_temp-type",
    "          CLI_DEP            = attr_temp-cli_dep",
    "          COMPONENT          = attr_temp-component",
    "          MINRELEASE         = attr_temp-minrelease",
    "          MAXRELEASE         = attr_temp-maxrelease",
    "          MODDATE            = attr_temp-moddate",
    "          MODTIME            = attr_temp-modtime",
    "          reftype            = l_reftype",
    "          refname            = l_refname",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          PROFILE_DONT_EXIST = 1",
    "          OTHERS             = 2.",
    "      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.",
    "        if l_reftype = 'BCFG' and l_refname = 'INTF'.",
    "          vals_in_int_fmt = abap_true.",
    "        endif.",
    "        attr_temp-version = version_new.",
    "        attr_temp-category = actopts-category.",
    "        modify bcsets_attrs from attr_temp.",
    "        if attr_temp-type = ptype_valtempl",
    "                                 or attr_temp-type = ptype_generated.",
    "          bcset_parent-bcset_id = attr_temp-id.",
    "          bcset_parent-act_status = err_no.",
    "          append bcset_parent to bcsets_parents.",
    "        endif.",
    "      else.",
    "        bcset_parent-bcset_id = attr_temp-id.",
    "        bcset_parent-act_status = err_no.",
    "        append bcset_parent to bcsets_parents.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* decompose hierarchical bc-sets:",
    "* table 'bcsets_attrs': only simple bcsets (the ones from the",
    "* hierarchical bc-sets are added)",
    "* table 'bcsets_parents': for each simple/hirarchical bc-set combination",
    "* an entry is added",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    clear: bcset_parent, bcset_temp.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp where type = ptype_template.",
    "      delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "      refresh: subprofs.",
    "      bcset_temp = attr_temp-id.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PRSET_DB_GET_SUBPROFS'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          PROFID     = bcset_temp",
    "          CATEGORY   = actopts-category",
    "          ALL_LEVELS = 'X'",
    "        TABLES",
    "          SUBPROFS   = subprofs.",
    "      loop at subprofs into subprof.",
    "* fill bcset_parents with simple bc-sets of hierarchical bc-sets",
    "          bcset_parent-bcset_id = subprof-id.",
    "          bcset_parent-parent_id = bcset_temp.",
    "          bcset_parent-act_status = err_no.",
    "        if subprof-type <> ptype_template.",
    "          append bcset_parent to bcsets_parents.",
    "* fill bcsets_attrs with simple bc-sets of hierarchical bc-sets",
    "          read table bcsets_attrs with key id       = subprof-id",
    "                                           category = subprof-category",
    "                                           transporting no fields.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            clear attr_temp.",
    "            attr_temp-id = subprof-id.",
    "            attr_temp-version  = version_new.",
    "            attr_temp-category = subprof-category.",
    "            attr_temp-type = subprof-type.",
    "            attr_temp-component = subprof-component.",
    "            attr_temp-minrelease = subprof-minrelease.",
    "            attr_temp-maxrelease = subprof-maxrelease.",
    "            append attr_temp to bcsets_attrs.",
    "          endif.",
    "        else.",
    "          append bcset_parent to bcsets_nodes.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endloop.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    free subprofs.",
    "    sort bcsets_attrs by id category.",
    "    delete adjacent duplicates from bcsets_attrs comparing id category.",
    "    sort bcsets_parents by bcset_id parent_id.",
    "    delete adjacent duplicates from bcsets_parents",
    "                                      comparing bcset_id parent_id.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check if bcset(s) are found for activation (hierarchical bcsets may",
    "* be given, without their simple bcsets being present in the system):",
    "* in dialog: stop activation with info (without protocol)",
    "* non-dialog: stop activation with protocol",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                                              and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    clear: rc_temp.",
    "    if bcsets_attrs[] is initial.",
    "      rc_temp = 1.",
    "    else.",
    "      read table bcsets_attrs with key type = ptype_valtempl",
    "                                            transporting no fields.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        read table bcsets_attrs with key type = ptype_generated",
    "                                              transporting no fields.",
    "        if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          rc_temp = 1.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "    if not rc_temp is initial.",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "        message i232.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW = err_end",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD = rc_activ.",
    "      else.",
    "        refresh: bcsets_attrs, bcsets_parents.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW = err_stop",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD = rc_activ.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID = actopts-act_id",
    "            MSGID  = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY  = err_error",
    "            MSGNO  = '232'.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write start entries for all of the bc-sets into activation protocol",
    "* and set status of them to 'success'",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at bcsets_parents into bcset_parent.",
    "      msgvar1 = bcset_parent-bcset_id.",
    "      call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "          bcset_id  = bcset_parent-bcset_id",
    "          parent_id = bcset_parent-parent_id",
    "          msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "          msgty     = err_no",
    "          msgno     = '250'",
    "          var1      = msgvar1",
    "          protoflag = 'X'.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",

    "*********************************************************************",
    "*                  check bcsets attributes",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* check if bcset(s) exist(s) in system -> remove all not existing",
    "* bcsets from activation list",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "          and rc_activ <> err_end and not bcsets_attrs[] is initial.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp where type is initial.",
    "      delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          ACT_ID   = actopts-act_id",
    "          BCSET_ID = attr_temp-id",
    "          MSGID    = 'SCPR'",
    "          MSGTY    = err_error",
    "          MSGNO    = '221'.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "          ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "          BCSET_ID       = attr_temp-id",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "          BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "      clear text.",
    "      PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "         USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "               'SCPR' err_error '221'",
    "               ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "         CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check component and release of bcsets:",
    "* in dialog: message for activation options popup -> prevent activation",
    "* non-dialog: stop activation with protocol entry",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    clear: bcset_temp, bcset_parent, rc_temp.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp.",
    "      clear: result, msgnum.",
    "      call function 'SCPR_CT_CHECK_RELEASE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          component  = attr_temp-component",
    "          minrelease = attr_temp-minrelease",
    "          maxrelease = attr_temp-maxrelease",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          result     = result.",
    "      case result.",
    "        when 'VALID'.                    \" all ok -> no action",
    "          continue.",
    "        when 'COMPONENT_DONT_EXIST'.     \" component does not exist",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e281 with ' '. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '281'.",
    "          msgvar1 = attr_temp-component.",
    "        when 'BCSET_TOO_NEW'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e302 with ' '. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '302'.                \" bcset is too new",
    "          msgvar1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "        when 'BCSET_OBSOLET'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e301 with ' '. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '301'.                \" bcset is too old",
    "          msgvar1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "      endcase.",
    "* remove bcset from activation list...",
    "      delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "* ...write message into activation protocol...",
    "      call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          act_id   = actopts-act_id",
    "          bcset_id = attr_temp-id",
    "          msgid    = 'SCPR'",
    "          msgty    = err_stop",
    "          msgno    = msgnum",
    "          var1     = msgvar1.",
    "* ...change activation status of bcset...",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_stop",
    "          ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_stop",
    "          BCSET_ID       = attr_temp-id",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "          BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "* ... keep error for activation option popup -> prevent activation",
    "        if result = 'COMPONENT_DONT_EXIST'.",
    "          concatenate 'Komponente:'(067) attr_temp-component",
    "                                           into text separated by space.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e286. endif.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_stop '286'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        else.",
    "          if attr_temp-maxrelease is initial.",
    "            concatenate 'Release:'(072) attr_temp-minrelease",
    "                                         into text separated by space.",
    "          else.",
    "            concatenate 'Releasebereich von:'(070) attr_temp-minrelease",
    "                                        'bis'(071) attr_temp-maxrelease",
    "                                         into text separated by space.",
    "          endif.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e459. endif.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_stop '459'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        endif.",
    "      else.",
    "* ...stop activation at non dialog activation",
    "        if result = 'COMPONENT_DONT_EXIST'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e286. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '286'.",
    "        else.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e206. endif.",
    "          msgnum = '206'.",
    "        endif.",
    "        perform stop_activation",
    "              using actopts-act_id msgnum ' '",
    "              changing rc_activ bcsets_attrs bcsets_parents.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check bcset type: no switch bcset allowed",
    "* in dialog: message for activation options popup -> prevent activation",
    "* non-dialog: stop activation with protocol entry",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp where category = pcat_switch.",
    "* error: 'switch bcset' at standard activation",
    "      if 1 = 2. message e590 with ' '. endif.",
    "      msgnum = '590'.",
    "* remove bcset from activation list...",
    "      delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "* ...get text from domain...",
    "      clear msgvar1.",
    "      refresh fixed_values.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          TABNAME      = 'SCPR_CTGRY'",
    "          FIELDNAME    = ' '",
    "          LANGU        = SY-LANGU",
    "          LFIELDNAME   = ' '",
    "          ALL_TYPES    = 'X'",
    "        TABLES",
    "          FIXED_VALUES = fixed_values.",
    "      if fixed_values is initial.",
    "        msgvar1 = pcat_switch.",
    "      else.",
    "        read table fixed_values into fixed_value",
    "                    with key low = attr_temp-category option = 'EQ'.",
    "        if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          msgvar1 = fixed_value-ddtext.",
    "        else.",
    "          msgvar1 = pcat_switch.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "* ...change activation status of bcset...",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_stop",
    "          ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_stop",
    "          BCSET_ID       = attr_temp-id",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "          BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "* ...write message into activation protocol...",
    "        call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            act_id   = actopts-act_id",
    "            bcset_id = attr_temp-id",
    "            msgid    = 'SCPR'",
    "            msgty    = err_stop",
    "            msgno    = msgnum",
    "            var1     = msgvar1.",
    "* ... keep error for activation option popup -> prevent activation",
    "        PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "           USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "                 'SCPR' err_stop '590'",
    "                 msgvar1 ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "           CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "      else.",
    "* ...stop activation at non dialog activation",
    "        perform stop_activation",
    "              using actopts-act_id msgnum msgvar1",
    "              changing rc_activ bcsets_attrs bcsets_parents.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.  \"bcsets",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* enquue bcsets",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "        and rc_activ <> err_end and not bcsets_attrs[] is initial.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp.",
    "      clear: msgnum, msgvar1, msgvar2.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_SV_ENQUEUE_BCSET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          BCSET_ID          = attr_temp-id",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          IS_ALREADY_LOCKED = 1",
    "          SYSTEM_FAILURE    = 2",
    "          OTHERS            = 3.",
    "      case sy-subrc.",
    "        when 0.",
    "        when 1.",
    "          msgnum = '417'.",
    "          msgvar1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "          msgvar2 = sy-msgv1.",
    "        when others.",
    "          msgnum = '418'.",
    "          msgvar1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "          clear msgvar2.",
    "      endcase.",
    "      if not msgnum is initial.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID   = actopts-act_id",
    "            BCSET_ID = attr_temp-id",
    "            MSGID    = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY    = err_error",
    "            MSGNO    = msgnum",
    "            VAR1     = msgvar1",
    "            VAR2     = msgvar2.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "            ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "            BCSET_ID       = attr_temp-id",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "            BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "        if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "          concatenate 'gesperrt von'(074) msgvar2",
    "                                 into text separated by space.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_error '419'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        endif.",
    "        delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*                  read bcset data",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp.",
    "      if sy-tabix = 1.",
    "* read first bcset",
    "        refresh: recattr, values, valuesl.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_TEMPL_DB_VALS_GET_DETAIL'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            PROFID   = attr_temp-id",
    "            CATEGORY = actopts-category",
    "          TABLES",
    "            VALUES   = values",
    "            VALUESL  = valuesl",
    "            RECATTR  = recattr.",
    "      else.",
    "        refresh: values_temp, valuesl_temp, recattr_temp.",
    "* read second to last bcset",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_TEMPL_DB_VALS_GET_DETAIL'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            PROFID   = attr_temp-id",
    "            CATEGORY = actopts-category",
    "          TABLES",
    "            VALUES   = values_temp",
    "            VALUESL  = valuesl_temp",
    "            RECATTR  = recattr_temp.",
    "        append lines of recattr_temp to recattr.",
    "        append lines of values_temp to values.",
    "        append lines of valuesl_temp to valuesl.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    free: values_temp, valuesl_temp.",
    "* table recattr should be sorted by id version tablename recnumber.",
    "* table values should be sorted by id version tablename recnumber",
    "* fieldname",
    "* table valuesl should be sorted by id version tablename recnumber",
    "* fieldname langu",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check if bcsets are empty",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at bcsets_attrs into attr_temp.",
    "      read table recattr with key id = attr_temp-id binary search",
    "                                            transporting no fields.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "* write message into activation protocol...",
    "        msgvar1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "        if 1 = 2. message e288 with ' '. endif.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID   = actopts-act_id",
    "            BCSET_ID = attr_temp-id",
    "            MSGID    = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY    = err_warning",
    "            MSGNO    = '288'",
    "            VAR1     = msgvar1.",
    "* ...set status for bcset...",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_warning",
    "            ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_warning",
    "            BCSET_ID       = attr_temp-id",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "            BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "* ...keep error message for activation popup",
    "        if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "          clear text.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING attr_temp-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_warning '416'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        endif.",
    "        delete bcsets_attrs.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check if bcsets are incomplete (only keys in records)",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    read table recattr with key uncomplete = 'U'",
    "                                             transporting no fields.",
    "    if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "* extract all bcsets with incomplete records",
    "      clear: bcset_temp.",
    "      refresh: recattr_temp.",
    "      loop at recattr assigning <wa_recattr> where uncomplete = 'U'.",
    "        if <wa_recattr>-id <> bcset_temp.",
    "          append <wa_recattr> to recattr_temp.",
    "        endif.",
    "        bcset_temp = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "      endloop.",
    "* treat each affected bcset individually...",
    "      loop at recattr_temp assigning <wa_recattr>.",
    "* ...write message into activation protocol...",
    "        if 1 = 2. message e526 with ' '. endif.",
    "        msgvar1 = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID   = actopts-act_id",
    "            BCSET_ID = <wa_recattr>-id",
    "            MSGID    = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY    = err_error",
    "            MSGNO    = '526'",
    "            VAR1     = msgvar1.",
    "* ...set status for bcset...",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "            ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "            BCSET_ID       = <wa_recattr>-id",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "            BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "* ...keep error message for activation popup...",
    "        if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "          clear text.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING <wa_recattr>-id ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_error '526'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        endif.",
    "* ...remove data of bcset",
    "        delete bcsets_attrs where id = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "        delete recattr where id = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "        delete values where id = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "        delete valuesl where id = <wa_recattr>-id.",
    "      endloop.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* at languages import -> remove non language dependent data",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "         and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-langu_only = answer_yes.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_REMOVE_NOLANGU_DATA'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        VALUESL = valuesl[]",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        RECATTR = recattr[]",
    "        VALUES  = values[].",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*        get and check customizing objects and tables",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* check and change the assignment of tables/objects and extract all",
    "* activation objects",
    "* content of recattr may be changed!",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    refresh: act_objects, objects_changed.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_EXTRACT_OBJECTS'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        actopts         = actopts",
    "        systype         = systype",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ACT_OBJECTS     = act_objects",
    "        OBJECTS_CHANGED = objects_changed",
    "      TABLES",
    "        RECATTR         = recattr",
    "      changing",
    "        rc_active = rc_activ.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* build status table of objects",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    clear object_status.",
    "    refresh: objects_stati.",
    "    loop at act_objects assigning <act_object>.",
    "      if object_status-objectname <> <act_object>-objectname",
    "           or object_status-objecttype <> <act_object>-objecttype",
    "           or object_status-bcset <> <act_object>-bcset.",
    "        object_status-objectname = <act_object>-objectname.",
    "        object_status-objecttype = <act_object>-objecttype.",
    "        object_status-bcset = <act_object>-bcset.",
    "        object_status-act_status = err_no.",
    "        append object_status to objects_stati.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    sort objects_stati.",
    "    delete adjacent duplicates from objects_stati",
    "                                              comparing all fields.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write start entries for all objects into activation protocol",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at objects_stati into object_status.",
    "      msgvar1 = object_status-objectname.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          ACT_ID     = actopts-act_id",
    "          BCSET_ID   = object_status-bcset",
    "          OBJECTNAME = object_status-objectname",
    "          OBJECTTYPE = object_status-objecttype",
    "          MSGID      = 'SCPR'",
    "          MSGTY      = err_no",
    "          MSGNO      = '252'",
    "          VAR1       = msgvar1",
    "          PROTOFLAG  = 'X'.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write protocol entries and set stati for changed object/table",
    "* assignments",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at objects_changed into object_changed.",
    "      msgvar1 = object_changed-tablename.",
    "      msgvar2 = object_changed-objectname.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          ACT_ID     = actopts-act_id",
    "          BCSET_ID   = object_changed-bcset",
    "          OBJECTNAME = object_changed-objectname",
    "          OBJECTTYPE = object_changed-objecttype",
    "          MSGID      = 'SCPR'",
    "          MSGTY      = err_info",
    "          MSGNO      = '266'",
    "          VAR1       = msgvar1",
    "          VAR2       = msgvar2.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_info",
    "          ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_info",
    "          BCSET_ID       = object_changed-bcset",
    "          OBJECTNAME     = object_changed-objectname",
    "          OBJECTTYPE     = object_changed-objecttype",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "          BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents",
    "          OBJECTS_STATI  = objects_stati.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    free objects_changed.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check which objects may not be activated due to system settings",
    "* and remove those",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    refresh: objvalues.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_SETTINGS_CHECK'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        CATEGORY           = pcat_classic",
    "        SYSTEM_CLIENT_EDIT = system_client_edit",
    "        SYS_CLIINDDEP_EDIT = sys_cliinddep_edit",
    "        SYSTEMEDIT         = systemedit",
    "        ACT_OBJECTS        = act_objects",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        OBJVALUES          = objvalues",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        ACTOPTS_CLAS       = actopts.",
    "* extract all objects which have to be removed",
    "    refresh: objvalues_temp.",
    "    loop at objvalues into objvalue_temp",
    "                              where act_flag = object_systerror.",
    "      append objvalue_temp to objvalues_temp.",
    "    endloop.",
    "* treat each individual object...",
    "    loop at objvalues_temp into objvalue_temp.",
    "      loop at objects_stati into object_status",
    "                     where objectname = objvalue_temp-objectname",
    "                     and   objecttype = objvalue_temp-objecttype.",
    "* ...set status...",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "            ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "            BCSET_ID       = object_status-bcset",
    "            OBJECTNAME     = objvalue_temp-objectname",
    "            OBJECTTYPE     = objvalue_temp-objecttype",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "            BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents",
    "            OBJECTS_STATI  = objects_stati.",
    "* ...write protocol entry...",
    "        msgvar1 = objvalue_temp-objectname.",
    "        if 1 = 2. message e360 with ' '. endif.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            ACT_ID     = actopts-act_id",
    "            BCSET_ID   = object_status-bcset",
    "            OBJECTNAME = objvalue_temp-objectname",
    "            OBJECTTYPE = objvalue_temp-objecttype",
    "            MSGID      = 'SCPR'",
    "            MSGTY      = err_error",
    "            MSGNO      = '360'",
    "            VAR1       = msgvar1.",
    "      endloop.",
    "* ...remove object data",
    "      PERFORM REMOVE_OBJECT_FROM_DATA",
    "         USING    ' ' ' ' objvalue_temp-objectname",
    "                  objvalue_temp-objecttype",
    "         CHANGING RECATTR[] VALUES[] VALUESL[] ACT_OBJECTS OBJVALUES",
    "                  BCSETS_ATTRS.",
    "    endloop.",
    "    free objvalues_temp.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check objects and tables...",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_OBJECT_CHECK'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        ACTOPTS        = actopts",
    "        CATEGORY       = actopts-category",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        RECATTR        = recattr[]",
    "        VALUES         = values[]",
    "        VALUESL        = valuesl[]",
    "        ACT_OBJECTS    = act_objects",
    "        OBJVALUES      = objvalues",
    "        BCSETS_ATTRS   = bcsets_attrs",
    "        RC_ACTIV       = rc_activ",
    "        BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents",
    "        OBJECTS_STATI  = objects_stati",
    "        ERRORS         = errors.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* handle transport numbers",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "     and rc_activ <> err_end and",
    "     ( actopts-cus_status = '0' or actopts-sys_status = '0' ).",
    "    refresh: errors_temp.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MN_TRANSP_HANDLE'",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        TRANSP_ERRORS = errors_temp",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        ACTOPTS       = actopts",
    "        OBJVALUES     = objvalues",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        USER_ABORT    = 1",
    "        OTHERS        = 2.",
    "    if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "        case sy-subrc.",
    "          when 0.",
    "          when 1.",
    "            PERFORM RETURNCODE_SET",
    "                USING    err_cancel",
    "                CHANGING rc_activ.",
    "          when others.",
    "            message i320.",
    "            PERFORM RETURNCODE_SET",
    "                USING    err_end",
    "                CHANGING rc_activ.",
    "        endcase.",
    "      else.",
    "        clear msgnum.",
    "        case sy-subrc.",
    "          when 0.",
    "          when 1.",
    "            msgnum = '018'. \"should not happen",
    "          when others.",
    "            msgnum = '320'.",
    "        endcase.",
    "        if not msgnum is initial.",
    "          clear msgvar1.",
    "          perform stop_activation",
    "                      using actopts-act_id msgnum msgvar1",
    "                      changing rc_activ bcsets_attrs bcsets_parents.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "    else.",
    "* check if transport errors happened",
    "      loop at errors_temp assigning <error_temp>.",
    "        clear transpcategory.",
    "        if <error_temp>-add_text = 'Fehler mit Systemtransport'(080).",
    "          transpcategory = tcategory_syst.",
    "        elseif <error_temp>-add_text =",
    "                              'Fehler mit Customizingtransport'(081).",
    "          transpcategory = tcategory_cust.",
    "        else.",
    "          perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",
    "          message e320 raising internal_error.",
    "        endif.",
    "        loop at objvalues into objvalue_temp",
    "                                where transpcategory = transpcategory.",
    "* set stati for transport errors",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              RC_ACTIV_NEW   = <error_temp>-msgty",
    "              ACT_STATUS_NEW = <error_temp>-msgty",
    "              OBJECTNAME     = objvalue_temp-objectname",

    "*************************************************",
    "* Remove BCSets that do not pass BAdI checks",
    "*************************************************",
    "  IF rc_activ <> err_cancel AND rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    DATA passed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF SCPR_ID.",
    "    DATA seen TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF SCPR_ID.",
    "    DATA index TYPE i.",
    "    DATA id TYPE SCPR_ID.",
    "    DATA var1 TYPE SYMSGV.",
    "    DATA it_proflist LIKE scprpprl OCCURS 10.",
    "    DATA subbc LIKE scprpprl.",
    "    DATA badi_check TYPE REF TO BADI_SCPR_ACT_PRECONDITION.",
    "    DATA messages TYPE BAPIRET2_T.",
    "    DATA badi_result TYPE SCPR_CHECK_RESULT.",
    "    FIELD-SYMBOLS <message> TYPE BAPIRET2.",
    "*************************************************",
    "*  Invoke the BAdI, and assemble list of BCSets",
    "*  that passed their tests.",
    "*************************************************",
    "    index = 1.",
    "    LOOP AT BCSET_IDS INTO bcset_parent.",
    "      APPEND bcset_parent-bcset_id TO seen.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    WHILE index <= LINES( seen ).",
    "      TRY.",
    "        READ TABLE seen INTO id INDEX index.",
    "        var1 = id.",
    "        index = index + 1.",
    "        badi_result = 'O'.",
    "        CLEAR messages.",
    "        GET BADI badi_check filters bcset_id = id.",
    "        CALL BADI badi_check->CHECK_PRECONDITION",
    "          EXPORTING iv_bcset_id = id",
    "                    it_variables = variables_new",
    "          CHANGING ct_diagnostic_messages = messages",
    "                   cv_check_result = badi_result.",
    "        LOOP AT messages ASSIGNING <message>.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "              bcset_id  = id",
    "              msgid     = <message>-id",
    "              msgty     = <message>-type",
    "              msgno     = <message>-number",
    "              var1      = <message>-message_v1",
    "              var2      = <message>-message_v2",
    "              var3      = <message>-message_v3",
    "              var4      = <message>-message_v4",
    "              .",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        CASE badi_result.",
    "        WHEN checkresult_ok.",
    "          APPEND id TO passed.",
    "          SELECT DISTINCT * FROM scprpprl INTO TABLE it_proflist",
    "            WHERE id      = id",
    "            AND   version = version_new.",
    "          LOOP AT it_proflist INTO subbc.",
    "            READ TABLE seen WITH TABLE KEY table_line = subbc-subprofile TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              APPEND subbc-subprofile TO seen.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        WHEN checkresult_skip.",
    "          IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE i857. ENDIF.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "              bcset_id  = id",
    "              msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "              msgty     = err_info",
    "              msgno     = msgno_checkresult_skip",
    "              var1      = var1",
    "              .",
    "        WHEN checkresult_skiperror.",
    "          rc_activ = err_error.",
    "          LOOP AT bcsets_parents INTO bcset_parent WHERE bcset_id = id.",
    "            IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e854. ENDIF.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "                bcset_id  = id",
    "                parent_id = bcset_parent-parent_id",
    "                msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "                msgty     = err_error",
    "                msgno     = msgno_checkresult_skiperror",
    "                var1      = var1",
    "               .",
    "            PERFORM RETURNCODE_SET",
    "              USING    err_error",
    "              CHANGING bcset_parent-act_status.",
    "            MODIFY bcsets_parents FROM bcset_parent TRANSPORTING act_status.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          LOOP AT bcsets_nodes INTO bcset_parent WHERE bcset_id = id.",
    "            IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e854. ENDIF.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "                bcset_id  = id",
    "                parent_id = bcset_parent-parent_id",
    "                msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "                msgty     = err_error",
    "                msgno     = msgno_checkresult_skiperror",
    "                var1      = var1",
    "               .",
    "            PERFORM RETURNCODE_SET",
    "              USING    err_error",
    "              CHANGING bcset_parent-act_status.",
    "            MODIFY bcsets_parents FROM bcset_parent TRANSPORTING act_status where bcset_id = bcset_parent-bcset_id.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        WHEN OTHERS.",
    "          IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e856. ENDIF.",
    "          var1 = badi_result.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "              bcset_id  = id",
    "              msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "              msgty     = err_info",
    "              msgno     = '856'",
    "              var1      = var1",
    "              .",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "      CATCH CX_SCPR_ABORT_ACTIVATION.",
    "        LOOP AT messages ASSIGNING <message>.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "              bcset_id  = id",
    "              msgid     = <message>-id",
    "              msgty     = <message>-type",
    "              msgno     = <message>-number",
    "              var1      = <message>-message_v1",
    "              var2      = <message>-message_v2",
    "              var3      = <message>-message_v3",
    "              var4      = <message>-message_v4",
    "              .",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e855. ENDIF.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            act_id    = actopts-act_id",
    "            bcset_id  = id",
    "            msgid     = 'SCPR'",
    "            msgty     = err_error",
    "            msgno     = msgno_checkresult_abort",
    "            var1      = var1",
    "            .",
    "         CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DB_DATA_WRITE'.",
    "         MESSAGE e855 WITH var1 RAISING wrong_parameters.",
    "      ENDTRY.",
    "    ENDWHILE.",
    "********************************************************************",
    "*   Loop over BCSets, identifying the BCSets that should not be activated",
    "*   and remove them from the constructs going forward.",
    "********************************************************************",
    "    LOOP AT bcsets_attrs INTO attr_temp.",

    "        PERFORM REMOVE_BCSET_FROM_DATA",

    "            USING    err_info",

    "        IF 1 = 2. MESSAGE e858. ENDIF.",
    "        var1 = attr_temp-id.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",

    "",
    "* Komprimieren der BC-Set Daten aus den Tabellen recattr, values und",
    "* valuesl in die Tabellen table_recs und table_descrs (bei allen",
    "* Aktivierungsarten)",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",

    "        VALUESL          = valuesl[]",
    "        TABLEDESCRS      = tabledescrs",

    "        TABLE_RECS       = table_recs",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        TABLEDESCR_ERROR = 1",
    "        OTHERS           = 2.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "      perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",

    "*********************************************************************",

    "*********************************************************************",
    "* check for key conflicts",

    "    refresh: it_conflicts.",
    "    call function 'SCPR_PRSET_MN_KEY_CONFLICT_SUB'",

    "        with_dialog      = '0'",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        rc               = rc_temp",
    "      TABLES",
    "        it_recs          = table_recs[]",
    "        it_descrs        = tabledescrs",
    "        it_conflicts     = it_conflicts",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        no_key_conflicts = 1.",
    "    if sy-subrc <> 1.",
    "* Protokolleintrag für Schlüsselkonflikte bei den betroffenen",
    "* BC-Sets",
    "      sort it_conflicts by id1 id2.",
    "      delete adjacent duplicates from it_conflicts comparing id1 id2.",
    "      loop at it_conflicts into it_conflict.",
    "        msgvar1 = it_conflict-id1.",
    "        msgvar2 = it_conflict-id2.",
    "        call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            act_id   = actopts-act_id",
    "            bcset_id = it_conflict-id1",
    "            msgid    = 'SCPR'",
    "            msgty    = err_error",
    "            msgno    = '209'",
    "            var1     = msgvar1",
    "            var2     = msgvar2.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "            ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "            BCSET_ID       = it_conflict-id1",
    "          CHANGING",
    "            RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "            BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "        if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "          concatenate 'Konflikt mit BC-Set'(073) it_conflict-id2",
    "                                     into text separated by space.",
    "          PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "             USING it_conflict-id1 ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                   'SCPR' err_error '461'",
    "                   ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "             CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "        endif.",
    "        if it_conflict-id1 <> it_conflict-id2.",
    "          call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              act_id   = actopts-act_id",
    "              bcset_id = it_conflict-id2",
    "              msgid    = 'SCPR'",
    "              msgty    = err_error",
    "              msgno    = '209'",
    "              var1     = msgvar2",
    "              var2     = msgvar1.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              RC_ACTIV_NEW   = err_error",
    "              ACT_STATUS_NEW = err_error",
    "              BCSET_ID       = it_conflict-id2",
    "            CHANGING",
    "              RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "              BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "          if actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "            concatenate 'Konflikt mit BC-Set'(073) it_conflict-id1",
    "                                       into text separated by space.",
    "            PERFORM SAVE_ERRORMESSAGE",
    "               USING it_conflict-id2 ' ' ' ' ' ' text",
    "                     'SCPR' err_error '461'",
    "                     ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "               CHANGING ERRORS.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endloop.",
    "      free it_conflicts.",
    "* Reaktionen im Aktivierungsvorgang in Abhängigkeit vom FB-Aufruf",
    "      if actopts-dialog = answer_no.",
    "        case actopts-safety.",
    "          when answer_no.",
    "            rc_activ = err_error.",
    "            call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                act_id = actopts-act_id",
    "                msgid  = 'SCPR'",
    "                msgty  = err_error",
    "                msgno  = '095'.",
    "          when answer_yes.",
    "            msgnum = '095'.",
    "            clear msgvar1.",
    "            perform stop_activation",
    "                        using actopts-act_id msgnum msgvar1",
    "                      changing rc_activ bcsets_attrs bcsets_parents.",
    "        endcase.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* calculate activation order of tables",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",

    "    refresh tablenames.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PRSET_CT_FKEY_DEPENDANCE'",
