    "      IMPORTING",
    "        TABLENAMES  = tablenames.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* fill table of subobjects (table 'act_parts')",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    refresh: act_parts.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PRSET_CT_RECS_INTO_OBJECT'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        OBJVALUES      = objvalues",
    "        ACT_OBJECTS    = act_objects",
    "        TABLEDESCRS    = tabledescrs",
    "        TABLENAMES     = tablenames",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ACT_PARTS      = act_parts",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        INTERNAL_ERROR = 1",
    "        OTHERS         = 2.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "      perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",
    "      message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "              with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "              raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    free tablenames.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* im safety fall überprüfen, ob schon warnungen oder fehler",
    "* festgestellt wurden und gegebenenfalls aktivierung abbrechen",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "      and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-dialog = answer_no",
    "                               and actopts-safety = answer_yes.",
    "    loop at bcsets_parents into bcset_parent.",
    "      if bcset_parent-act_status <> err_no",
    "                          and bcset_parent-act_status <> err_info.",
    "        msgnum = '237'.",
    "        clear msgvar1.",
    "        perform stop_activation",
    "                    using actopts-act_id msgnum msgvar1",
    "                    changing rc_activ bcsets_attrs bcsets_parents.",
    "        exit.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* in dialog show the activation options",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end",
    "                            and actopts-dialog = answer_yes.",
    "    actopts-rc_activ = rc_activ.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_IF_ACTOPTIONS'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        ERRORS                = errors",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        ACTOPTS               = actopts",
    "        LANGUAGES             = languages",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        USER_ABORT            = 1",
    "        USER_ABBORT_WITH_PROT = 2",
    "        INTERNAL_ERROR        = 3",
    "        OTHERS                = 4.",
    "    case sy-subrc.",
    "      when 0.",
    "      when 1.",
    "        rc_activ = err_cancel.",
    "      when 2.",
    "        actopts-simulat_on = answer_yes.",
    "      when others.",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "          perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",
    "          message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                  with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "    endcase.",
    "    free errors.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* set importable-flags at unchecked activation",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "     and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-unchecked = answer_yes.",
    "    loop at act_parts assigning <act_part>",
    "                              where not importable is initial.",
    "      clear <act_part>-importable.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* remove after-import-methods for objects which will be activated",
    "* in checked standard mode ('importable = X' and objecttype = C,V,S)",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                                           and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    loop at act_parts assigning <act_part>",
    "                                   where not afterimport is initial.",
    "      if not <act_part>-importable is initial and",
    "                           ( <act_part>-objecttype = otype_view or",
    "                             <act_part>-objecttype = otype_cluster or",
    "                             <act_part>-objecttype = otype_table ).",
    "        clear <act_part>-afterimport.",
    "        clear <act_part>-mult_obj_aftimp.",
    "        clear <act_part>-aftimp_method.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endloop.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write activation protocol entries into DB",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DB_DATA_WRITE'.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* keep DB changes so far...",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-no_commit is initial.",
    "    commit work.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* start-signal for customizing distribution",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCTM_BCSET_ACTIVATION_FRAME'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        IV_ACT_ID            = actopts-act_id",
    "        IV_END_OF_ACTIVATION = ' '.",
    "  endif.",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* Register the commit and rollback handler for the SAP LUW",
    "* In case of rollback mark the activation log as not finished and",
    "* add a protocol entry. Otherwise just remove the activation id table",
    "* from ABAP memory.",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "     and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-no_commit EQ ABAP_TRUE.",
    "    DATA: lt_act_ids TYPE scpr_act_id_tab,",
    "          act_transaction TYPE SYCHAR32.",
    "    CALL METHOD CL_SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_STATE=>GET_SAP_LUW_KEY",
    "      RECEIVING",
    "        SAP_LUW_KEY = act_transaction.",
    "    IMPORT act_tab = lt_act_ids FROM MEMORY ID act_transaction.",
    "    INSERT actopts-act_id INTO TABLE lt_act_ids.",
    "    EXPORT act_tab = lt_act_ids TO MEMORY ID act_transaction.",
    "    PERFORM WRITE_PROTOCOL_ON_ROLLBACK ON ROLLBACK.",
    "    PERFORM WRITE_PROTOCOL_ON_ROLLBACK ON COMMIT.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*             perform main import phase",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "     and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-simulat_on = answer_no.",
    "    refresh: aft_imp_data.",
    "* perform standard activation",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PRSET_CT_IMPORT_INDUSTRY'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        LANGUAGES      = languages",
    "        values_in_int_format = vals_in_int_fmt",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        AFT_IMP_DATA   = aft_imp_data",
    "      CHANGING",
    "        ACTOPTS        = actopts",
    "        RC_ACTIV       = rc_activ",
    "        BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents",
    "        OBJECTS_STATI  = objects_stati",
    "        ACT_PARTS      = act_parts",
    "        TABLE_RECS     = table_recs",
    "        TABLEDESCRS    = tabledescrs",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        INTERNAL_ERROR = 1",
    "        OTHERS         = 2.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "      perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",
    "      message id SY-MSGID type SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "              with SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "              raising INTERNAL_ERROR.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*             finish main import phase",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* write and transport variable activation links (scpractx): da der",
    "* zusammenhang zwischen den variablen und den customizingobjekten nicht",
    "* mehr da ist (!!!!!), werden hier generell (d.h unabhängig vom",
    "* aktivierungsstatus des prozesses oder der einzelnen objekte) ALLE",
    "* variablen aktivierungslinks geschrieben und transportiert (letzteres",
    "* in den sys-transport wenn vorhanden, falls nicht dann in den",
    "* cust-transport (wenn dieser vorhanden)",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "        and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-simulat_on = answer_no.",
    "*         and actopts-actlinks <> actlinks_no.",
    "    clear: task_number, task_category, task_number_used.",
    "    refresh: errors_temp.",
    "    if not actopts-task_syst is initial and actopts-sys_status = '0'.",
    "      task_number = actopts-task_syst.",
    "      task_category = tcategory_syst.",
    "    elseif not actopts-task_cust is initial",
    "                                       and actopts-cus_status = '0'.",
    "      task_number = actopts-task_cust.",
    "      task_category = tcategory_cust.",
    "    endif.",
    "    if task_number is initial.",
    "* write variable activation links without transport",
    "      call function 'SCPR_HIST_DB_VARIABLES_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          variables_new = variables_new.",
    "    else.",
    "* write variable activation links with transport",
    "      refresh: e071_temp, e071k_temp.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_HIST_DB_VARIABLES_WRITE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          VARIABLES_NEW = variables_new",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          E071_TEMP     = e071_temp",
    "          E071K_TEMP    = e071k_temp.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_CT_TRANSPORT_LOAD'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          WITH_DIALOG      = actopts-dialog",
    "          TASK_NUMBER      = task_number",
    "          TASK_CATEGORY    = task_category",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          TASK_NUMBER_USED = task_number_used",
    "          TRANSP_ERRORS    = errors_temp",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          E071_TRANSP      = e071_temp",
    "          E071K_TRANSP     = e071k_temp.",
    "      free: e071_temp, e071k_temp.",
    "      if task_number_used <> task_number and",
    "                                   not task_number_used is initial.",
    "* if not default transport is used -> add 'scpr' info message",
    "        clear error_temp.",
    "        error_temp-msgid = 'SCPR'.",
    "        error_temp-msgty = 'I'.",
    "        error_temp-msgno = '566'.",
    "        if 1 = 2. message e566 with ' '. endif.",
    "        error_temp-msgv1 = task_number_used.",
    "        append error_temp to errors_temp.",
    "      endif.",
    "* treat errors: for each bcset with variables ->",
    "* set stati, add activation protocol messages",
    "      loop at bcsets_parents into bcset_parent.",
    "        read table variables_new",
    "                           with key bcset = bcset_parent-bcset_id",
    "                           transporting no fields.",
    "        if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          loop at errors_temp into error_temp.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                RC_ACTIV_NEW   = error_temp-msgty",
    "                ACT_STATUS_NEW = error_temp-msgty",
    "                BCSET_ID       = bcset_parent-bcset_id",
    "                BCSETS_ALL     = ' '",
    "              CHANGING",
    "                RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "                BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                ACT_ID    = actopts-act_id",
    "                BCSET_ID  = bcset_parent-bcset_id",
    "                PARENT_ID = bcset_parent-parent_id",
    "                MSGID     = error_temp-msgid",
    "                MSGTY     = error_temp-msgty",
    "                MSGNO     = error_temp-msgno",
    "                VAR1      = error_temp-msgv1",
    "                VAR2      = error_temp-msgv2",
    "                VAR3      = error_temp-msgv3",
    "                VAR4      = error_temp-msgv4.",
    "          endloop.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endloop.",
    "    endif.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* dequeue bcsets",
    "  perform dequeue_bcsets using bcsets_attrs.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write end entry for main import phase into activation protocol",
    "  if 1 = 2. message e270. endif.",
    "  call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      act_id = actopts-act_id",
    "      msgid  = 'SCPR'",
    "      msgty  = err_no",
    "      msgno  = '270'.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write activation protocol entries into DB",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DB_DATA_WRITE'.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* keep DB changes so far...",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-no_commit is initial.",
    "    commit work.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*             perform after-import-methods",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "     and rc_activ <> err_end and actopts-simulat_on = answer_no",
    "                             and actopts-after_imp = answer_yes.",
    "* write start entry for after-import phase into activation protocol",
    "    if 1 = 2. message e822. endif.",
    "    call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        act_id = actopts-act_id",
    "        msgid  = 'SCPR'",
    "        msgty  = err_no",
    "        msgno  = '822'.",
    "    if not aft_imp_data is initial.",
    "* perform after-import-methods",
    "      refresh errors_temp.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_RUN_AFT_IMP_METHODS'",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          MESSAGES     = errors_temp",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          AFT_IMP_DATA = aft_imp_data.",
    "* write after-import messages into activation protocol",
    "      if not errors_temp is initial.",
    "        sort errors_temp by objectname objecttype.",
    "        loop at errors_temp assigning <error_temp>.",
    "          loop at objects_stati into object_status",
    "                         where objectname = <error_temp>-objectname",
    "                         and   objecttype = <error_temp>-objecttype.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_MODIFY_STATUS'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                RC_ACTIV_NEW   = <error_temp>-msgty",
    "                ACT_STATUS_NEW = <error_temp>-msgty",
    "                BCSET_ID       = object_status-bcset",
    "                OBJECTNAME     = <error_temp>-objectname",
    "                OBJECTTYPE     = <error_temp>-objecttype",
    "              CHANGING",
    "                RC_ACTIV_OLD   = rc_activ",
    "                BCSETS_PARENTS = bcsets_parents",
    "                OBJECTS_STATI  = objects_stati.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                ACT_ID     = actopts-act_id",
    "                BCSET_ID   = object_status-bcset",
    "                OBJECTNAME = <error_temp>-objectname",
    "                OBJECTTYPE = <error_temp>-objecttype",
    "                MSGID      = <error_temp>-msgid",
    "                MSGTY      = <error_temp>-msgty",
    "                MSGNO      = <error_temp>-msgno",
    "                VAR1       = <error_temp>-msgv1",
    "                VAR2       = <error_temp>-msgv2",
    "                VAR3       = <error_temp>-msgv3",
    "                VAR4       = <error_temp>-msgv4.",
    "          endloop.",
    "        endloop.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "* write end entry for after-import phase into activation protocol",
    "    if 1 = 2. message e823. endif.",
    "    call function 'SCPR_PR_DATA_WRITE'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        act_id = actopts-act_id",
    "        msgid  = 'SCPR'",
    "        msgty  = err_no",
    "        msgno  = '823'.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "*              finish activation process",
    "*********************************************************************",
    "* end-signal for customizing distribution",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_stop and rc_activ <> err_cancel",
    "                          and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCTM_BCSET_ACTIVATION_FRAME'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        IV_ACT_ID            = actopts-act_id",
    "        IV_END_OF_ACTIVATION = 'X'.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* set message variable for activation type (activation or simulation)",
    "  if actopts-simulat_on = answer_yes.",
    "    msgvar_type = 'Aktivierungssimulation'(002).",
    "  else.",
    "    msgvar_type = 'Aktivierung'(003).",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* write 'end-entries' of activation process for all objects into",
    "* activation protocol",
    "  if rc_activ <> err_cancel and rc_activ <> err_end.",
    "    if rc_activ = err_stop.",
    "      loop at objects_stati into object_status.",
    "        object_status-act_status = err_stop.",
    "        modify objects_stati from object_status.",
    "      endloop.",
    "    endif.",
    "    loop at objects_stati into object_status.",
    "      msgvar1 = object_status-objectname.",
    "      case object_status-act_status.",
    "        when err_stop.",
    "          msgtype = err_stop.",
    "          msgnum = '421'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e421 with ' ' ' '. endif.",
    "        when err_no.",
    "          msgtype = err_no.",
    "          msgnum = '255'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e255 with ' ' ' '. endif.",
    "        when err_info.",
    "          msgtype = err_info.",
    "          msgnum  = '420'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e420 with ' ' ' '. endif.",
    "        when err_warning.",
    "          msgtype = err_warning.",
    "          msgnum = '279'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e279 with ' ' ' '. endif.",
    "        when err_error.",
    "          msgtype = err_error.",
    "          msgnum = '259'.",
    "          if 1 = 2. message e259 with ' ' ' '. endif.",

    "FUNCTION SCPR_ACTIV_MN_TRANSP_HANDLE.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",

    "*\"      USER_ABORT",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 1. set transport flags (actopts-cus_status and actopts-sys_status):",

    "",

    "  endif.",
    "",
    "",
    "* check which transports are necessary",

    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",

    "",

    "bcset_actinfo-mandant     = mandant.",
